G5316.def:
**φαίνω**
[in LXX for אוֹר hi., רָאָה ni., etc. ;]
I. Act.,
1. to bring to light, cause to appear (so most frequently in cl.).
2. Absol., **to give light, shine **(Hom., Plat., al.): [[Jhn.1.5; 5.35|Jhn.1:5 5:35]], [[2Pe.1.19|2Pe.1:19]], [[1Jn.2.8|1Jn.2:8]], [[Rev.1.16; 8.12; 18.23; 21.23|Rev.1:16 8:12 18:23 21:23]].
II. Pass., **to come to light, appear, be manifest**: [[Mat.2.7; 13.26; 24.27, 30|Mat.2:7 13:26 24:27, 30]], [[Luk.9.8|Luk.9:8]], [[Php.2.15|Php.2:15]], [[Heb.11.3|Heb.11:3]], [[1Pe.4.18|1Pe.4:18]]" (LXX) ; opposite to ἀφανίζεσθαι, [[Jhn.4.14|Jhn.4:14]] with dative of person(s) (Bl. § 54, 4), [[Mat.1.20; 2.13, 19|Mat.1:20 2:13, 19]] [[Mrk.16.9|Mrk.16:9]]; with nom. pred., [[Mat.23.27-28|Mat.23:27-28]], [[Rom.7.13|Rom.7:13]], [[2Co.13.7|2Co.13:7]]; id. with dative of person(s), [[Mat.6.5, 16; 6.18|Mat.6:5, 16 6:18]] (before nom. ptcp., but not as in cl.; see Bl., § 73, 4); impers., [[Mat.9.33|Mat.9:33]] of the mind and judgment (= δοκεῖ, which see), [[Mrk.14.64|Mrk.14:64]] (cf. I [[Est.2.21|Est.2:21]]), [[Luk.24.11|Luk.24:11]].†
_SYN._: see: δοκέω (AS)

G5399.def:
**φοβέέω**, ῶ
(φόβος) [in LXX chiefly for מִן יָרֵא ;]
1. in Hem., to put to flight. Pass., to be put to flight, to flee affrighted
2. to terrify, frighten (Wis 179; Hdt. and Att..). Pass. (so always in NT; cf. M, _Pr._, 162), **to be seized with fear, be affrighted, fear**: [[Mat.10.31; 14.27|Mat.10:31 14:27]], [[Mrk.5.33; 6.50|Mrk.5:33 6:50]], [[Luk.1.13; 8.50|Luk.1:13 8:50]], [[Jhn.6.19; 12.15|Jhn.6:19 12:15]], [[Act.16.38|Act.16:38]], al.; opposite to ὑψηλοφρονεῖν, [[Rom.11.20|Rom.11:20]] σφόδρα, [[Mat.17.6; 27.54|Mat.17:6 27:54]]; with cogn. accusative, φόβον μέγαν, [[Mrk.4.41|Mrk.4:41]], [[Luk.2.9|Luk.2:9]] ([[1Ma.10.8|1Ma.10:8]]); φόβον αὐτῶν (obj, genitive, but cf. _ICC_, in l), [[1Pe.3.14|1Pe.3:14]] πτόησιν, [[1Pe.3.6|1Pe.3:6]] with accusative of person(s), [[Mat.10.26|Mat.10:26]], [[Mrk.11.18|Mrk.11:18]], [[Luk.19.21|Luk.19:21]], [[Jhn.9.22|Jhn.9:22]], [[Act.9.26|Act.9:26]],
[[Rom.13.3|Rom.13:3]], al.; before ἀπό (like _Heb._ יָרֵא, [[Jer.1.8|Jer.1:8]], al.; cf. M, _Pr._, 102, 104n„), [[Mat.10.28|Mat.10:28]], [[Luk.12.4|Luk.12:4]]; before μή (cl.; Bl., § 65, 3; M, _Pr._, 184 f.), [[Act.23.10; 27.17|Act.23:10 27:17]]; μήπως, [[Act.27.29|Act.27:29]], [[2Co.11.3; 12.20|2Co.11:3 12:20]], [[Gal.4.11|Gal.4:11]]; μήποτε, [[Heb.4.1|Heb.4:1]] with inf. (Bl., § 69, 4; M, _Pr._, 205), [[Mat.1.20|Mat.1:20]], [[Mrk.9.32|Mrk.9:32]], al.; of reverential fear: [[Mrk.6.20|Mrk.6:20]], [[Eph.5.33|Eph.5:33]]; τ. θεόν, [[Luk.1.50|Luk.1:50]], [[Act.10.2|Act.10:2]], [[1Pe.2.17|1Pe.2:17]], [[Rev.14.7|Rev.14:7]], al.; τ. κύριον, [[Col.3.22|Col.3:22]], [[Rev.15.4|Rev.15:4]]; τ. ὄνομα τ. θεοῦ (see: ὄνομα), [[Rev.11.18|Rev.11:18]] οἱ φοβούμενοι τ. θεόν, of proselytes, [[Act.13.16, 26|Act.13:16, 26]] (cf. ἐκ-φοβέω)
(AS)

G5343.def:
**φεύγω **
[in LXX chiefly for נוּס, also for בָּרַח, etc. ;]
**to flee from or away, take flight**: absol., [[Mat.8.33; 26.56|Mat.8:33 26:56]], [[Mrk.5.14; 14.50|Mrk.5:14 14:50]], [[Luk.8.34|Luk.8:34]], [[Jhn.10.12|Jhn.10:12]], [[Act.7.29|Act.7:29]]; before εἰς, [[Mat.2.13; 10.23; 24.16|Mat.2:13 10:23 24:16]] (WH, txt.), [[Mrk.13.14|Mrk.13:14]], [[Luk.21.21|Luk.21:21]], [[Rev.12.6|Rev.12:6]]; ἐπί, with accusative loc., [[Mat.24.16|Mat.24:16]] (WH, mg.); ἐκ, [[Act.27.30|Act.27:30]] ἀπό, with genitive loc. (cl.), [[Mrk.16.8|Mrk.16:8]] id. with genitive of person(s) (as in _Heb._), [[Jhn.10.5|Jhn.10:5]], [[Jas.4.7|Jas.4:7]]. Metaphorical: absol., [[Rev.16.20|Rev.16:20]] with accusative of thing(s), [[1Co.6.18|1Co.6:18]], [[Heb.11.34|Heb.11:34]] (see M, Fr., 116); opposite to διώκειν, [[1Ti.6.11|1Ti.6:11]], [[2Ti.2.22|2Ti.2:22]]; before άπό, with genitive of person(s), [[Rev.9.6|Rev.9:6]] άπὸ τ. προσώπου, [[Rev.20.11|Rev.20:11]] with genitive of thing(s), [[Mat.3.7|Mat.3:7]] (M, _Pr._, l.with) [[Mat.23.33|Mat.23:33]], [[Luk.3.7|Luk.3:7]], [[1Co.10.14|1Co.10:14]] (cf. ἀπο-, δια-, ἐκ-, κατα-φεύγω).†
(AS)

G5330.def:
**Φαρισαῖος**, -ου, ὁ (Aram. פְּרִישָׁא; see Dalman, **Gr.**, 157.n, Words, 2.n),
**a Pharisee**: [[Mat.23.26|Mat.23:26]], [[Php.3.5|Php.3:5]]; usually in pl., [[Mat.9.11|Mat.9:11]], [[Mrk.2.18|Mrk.2:18]], al.; Φ. κ. γραμματεῖς, [[Mat.5.20|Mat.5:20]], [[Mrk.2.16|Mrk.2:16]], [[Luk.5.21|Luk.5:21]], al.; Φ. κ. Σαδδυκαῖοι, [[Mat.16.1|Mat.16:1]], [[Act.23.6|Act.23:6]], 7 al.; ἀρχιερεῖς, [[Mat.21.45|Mat.21:45]], [[Jhn.7.32|Jhn.7:32]], al. (see _DB_, iii, 826b).
(AS)

G5306.def:
**ὕστερος**, -α, -ον
[in LXX for אַחֲרוֹן and cogn. forms ;]
**latter, later**: ἐν ὑ. καιροῖς, [[1Ti.4.1|1Ti.4:1]] (on the reading ὁ ὕ., WH, for ὁ πρῶτος, see WH, _App._, in l). Neut., τὸ ὕ., used adverbially instead of ὑστέρως, **afterwards, later**: [[Mat.4.2; 21.29, 32; 21.37; 25.11; 26.60|Mat.4:2 21:29, 32 21:37 25:11 26:60]], [[Mrk.16.14|Mrk.16:14]], [[Luk.20.32|Luk.20:32]], [[Jhn.13.36|Jhn.13:36]], [[Heb.12.11|Heb.12:11]]; with genitive, [[Mat.22.27|Mat.22:27]]†
(AS)

G5346.def:
**φημί **
[in LXX chiefly for נָאַם, also for אָמַר; frequently in 2-4 Mac ;]
**to declare, say**: frequently in quoting the words of another, [[Mat.13.29; 26.61|Mat.13:29 26:61]], [[Luk.7.40; 22.58|Luk.7:40 22:58]], [[Jhn.1.23|Jhn.1:23]], al.; interjected into the recorded words (cl.), [[Mat.14.8|Mat.14:8]], [[Act.23.35|Act.23:35]], al.; φησί, impersonal (Bl., § 30, 4), [[1Co.6.16|1Co.6:16]] (Lft., _Notes_, 217; but cf. Bl., l.with), [[2Co.10.10|2Co.10:10]] (WH, mg., φασίν), [[Heb.8.5|Heb.8:5]] joined with syn. verb (cf. LS, see word, II, 2), ἀποκριθεὶς αὐτῷ ἔφη, [[Luk.23.3|Luk.23:3]] before -πρός, [[Luk.22.70|Luk.22:70]], al.; with accusative of thing(s), [[1Co.10.15; 10.19|1Co.10:15 10:19]]; accusative and inf., [[Rom.3.8|Rom.3:8]] before ὅτι (Bl., § 70, 3), [[1Co.10.19; 15.50|1Co.10:19 15:50]] (cf. σύν-φημι)
(AS)

G5308.def:
**ὑψηλός**, -ή, -όν
[in LXX chiefly for בָּמָה, also for בָּמָה, רוּם, etc. ;]
**high, lofty**: ὄρος, [[Mat.4.8; 17.1|Mat.4:8 17:1]], [[Mrk.9.2|Mrk.9:2]], [[Rev.21.10|Rev.21:10]]; τεῖχος, [[Rev.21.12|Rev.21:12]] μετὰ βραχίονος., figuratively, [[Act.13.17|Act.13:17]] (cf. [[Exo.6.6|Exo.6:6]], al); pl., ὑψηλά, of heaven ([[Psa.93.4|Psa.93:4]], [[Isa.33.5|Isa.33:5]], al.), [[Heb.1.3|Heb.1:3]]; compar., ὑψηλότερος τ. οὐρανῶν, [[Heb.7.26|Heb.7:26]] Metaph: [[Luk.16.15|Luk.16:15]] ὑψηλὰ ψρσνεῖν, [[Rom.11.20; 12.16|Rom.11:20 12:16]], [[1Ti.6.17|1Ti.6:17]] (WH, txt., ὑψηλοφρονείν).†
(AS)

G5368.def:
**φιλέω**, -ῶ
(φίλος), [in LXX: [[Gen.27.4|Gen.27:4]], 9, al. (אָהַב), [[Gen.27.27|Gen.27:27]], al. (נָשַׁק), [[Lam.1.2|La 1:2]] (רֵעַ) [[Wis.8.2|Wis.8:2]], al. ;]
1. **to love **(with the love of emotion and friendship, Lat, amare; v, _SYN._): with accusative of person(s), [[Mat.10.37|Mat.10:37]], [[Jhn.5.20|Jhn.5:20]]; [[Jhn.11.3, 36; 15.19; 16.27; 20.2; 21.15-17|Jhn.11:3, 36 15:19 16:27 20:2 21:15-17]], [[1Co.16.22|1Co.16:22]], [[Rev.3.19|Rev.3:19]]; ἐν πίστει, [[Tit.3.15|Tit.3:15]] with accusative of thing(s), [[Mat.23.6|Mat.23:6]], [[Luk.20.46|Luk.20:46]], [[Jhn.12.25|Jhn.12:25]], [[Rev.22.15|Rev.22:15]]; with inf. ([[Isa.56.10|Isa.56:10]] cf. Bl., § 69, 4), [[Mat.6.5|Mat.6:5]]
2. **to kiss**: with accusative of person(s), [[Mat.26.48|Mat.26:48]], [[Mrk.14.44|Mrk.14:44]], [[Luk.22.47|Luk.22:47]] (cf. κατα-φιλέω).†
_SYN._: ἀγαπάω ω (which see), the love of duty and respect (AS)

G5315.def:
**φάγομαι**Hellenistic for cl. ἔδομαι, see: ἐσθίω.
**ἐσθίω**, and (poet, and late prose) ἔσθω,
[in LXX chiefly for אכל ;]
**to eat**;
(a) absol.: [[Mat.14.20, 21|Mat.14:20, 21]] [[Mrk.6.31|Mrk.6:31]], [[Jhn.4.31|Jhn.4:31]], al.; ἐν τ. φαγεῖν (on this aor. form, see M, _Pr._, 111), [[1Co.11.21|1Co.11:21]] διδόναι φαγεῖν, with dative of person(s), [[Mrk.5.43|Mrk.5:43]], al.; ἐ. καὶ πίνειν, [[Mat.6.25, 31|Mat.6:25, 31]] [[Luk.10.7|Luk.10:7]], al.; of ordinary use of food and drink, [[1Co.9.4; 11.22|1Co.9:4 11:22]]; of partaking of food at table, [[Mrk.2.16|Mrk.2:16]], [[Luk.5.30|Luk.5:30]], al.; opposite to fasting, [[Mat.11.18|Mat.11:18]], [[Luk.5.33|Luk.5:33]], al.; of revelling, [[Mat.24.49|Mat.24:49]], [[Luk.12.45|Luk.12:45]] .
(b) with accusative of thing(s): [[Mat.6.25|Mat.6:25]], [[Mrk.1.6|Mrk.1:6]], [[Jhn.6.31|Jhn.6:31]], [[Rom.14.2|Rom.14:2]], al.; ἄρτον (Heb. אָכַל לֶחֶם), [[Mat.15.2|Mat.15:2]], [[Mrk.3.20|Mrk.3:20]], al.; τὸν ἑαυτοῦ ἄ., [[2Th.3.12|2Th.3:12]] ἄ. before παρά, genitive of person(s), [[2Th.3.8|2Th.3:8]] τά before id., [[Luk.10.7|Luk.10:7]] τ. πάσχα, [[Mat.26.17|Mat.26:17]], [[Mrk.14.12|Mrk.14:12]] al; τ. κυριακὸν δεῖπνον, [[1Co.11.20|1Co.11:20]] τ. θυσίας, [[1Co.10.18|1Co.10:18]] before ἐκ (= cl. part. genitive), [[Jhn.6.26|Jhn.6:26]], 5o, 51, [[1Co.11.28|1Co.11:28]]; ἀπό (cf. Heb. אָכַל מִן), [[Mat.15.27|Mat.15:27]], [[Mrk.7.28|Mrk.7:28]]; metaphorically, **to devour, consume**: [[Heb.10.27|Heb.10:27]], [[Jas.5.3|Jas.5:3]], [[Rev.17.16|Rev.17:16]] (cf. κατ-, συν-εσθίω) .
(AS)

G5384.def:
**φίλος**, -η, -ον
[in LXX chiefly for רֵעַ, אָהַב ;]
1. pass., beloved, dear (Hom., Eur., al.).
2. Act., **loving, friendly **(in cl. less frequently and only in poets): [[Act.19.31|Act.19:31]] As subst., a friend;
(a) masc., ὁ φ.: [[Luk.7.6; 11.5; 14.10; 15.6; 16.9; 21.16; 23.12|Luk.7:6 11:5 14:10 15:6 16:9 21:16 23:12]], [[Act.27.3|Act.27:3]], [[3Jn.14|3Jn.14]]; opposite to δοῦλος, [[Jhn.15.15|Jhn.15:15]] φ. ἀναγκαῖοι, [[Act.10.24|Act.10:24]] with genitive subj., [[Mat.11.19|Mat.11:19]], [[Luk.7.34; 11.6, 8; 12.4; 14.12; 15.29|Luk.7:34 11:6, 8 12:4 14:12 15:29]], [[Jhn.11.11; 15.13-14|Jhn.11:11 15:13-14]]; ὁ φ. τοῦ νυμφίου, [[Jhn.3.29|Jhn.3:29]] τ. Καίσαρος (see Deiss., BS 167; _LAE_, 382 f.), [[Jhn.19.12|Jhn.19:12]] θεοῦ (see Hort, in l), [[Jas.2.23|Jas.2:23]] with genitive of thing(s), τ, κόσμου, [[Jas.4.4|Jas.4:4]]
(b) fem., ἡ φ., [[Luk.15.9|Luk.15:9]],†
(AS)

G5312.def:
**ὑψόω**, -ῶ
(ὕψος), [in LXX chiefly for רוּם, also for גָּבַהּ, נָשָׂא, etc. ;]
**to lift or raise up**: with accusative, [[Jhn.3.14; 8.28; 12.32, 34|Jhn.3:14 8:28 12:32, 34]]; ἕως τ. οὐρανοῦ, figuratively, pass., [[Mat.11.23|Mat.11:23]], [[Luk.10.15|Luk.10:15]]. Metaphorical, **to exalt, uplift**: [[Act.2.33; 5.31|Act.2:33 5:31]], [[2Co.11.7|2Co.11:7]], [[Jas.4.10|Jas.4:10]], [[1Pe.5.6|1Pe.5:6]]; opposite to ταπεινῶ, [[Luk.1.52|Luk.1:52]] ἑαυτόν, [[Mat.23.12|Mat.23:12]], [[Luk.4.11; 18.14|Luk.4:11 18:14]] (cf. ὑπερ-υψόω).†
(AS)

G5318.def:
**φανερός**, -ά, -όν
(φαίνομαι) [in LXX: [[Deu.29.29|Deu.29:29]] (28) (גָּלָה ni.), [[Pro.14.4|Pro.14:4]], [[Sir.6.22|Sir.6:22]], al. ;]
**open to sight, visible, manifest**: [[Gal.5.19|Gal.5:19]] before ἐν, [[Rom.1.19|Rom.1:19]], [[1Jn.3.10|1Jn.3:10]]; with dative of person(s), [[Act.4.16; 7.13|Act.4:16 7:13]], [[1Ti.4.15|1Ti.4:15]]; φ. γίνεσθαι (in LXX for בָּחַן ni., [[Gen.42.16|Gen.42:16]]), [[Mrk.6.14|Mrk.6:14]], [[Luk.8.17|Luk.8:17]], [[1Co.3.13; 14.25|1Co.3:13 14:25]]; id. before ἐν, [[1Co.11.19|1Co.11:19]], [[Php.1.13|Php.1:13]]; φ. ποιεῖν, [[Mat.12.16|Mat.12:16]], [[Mrk.3.12|Mrk.3:12]]; εἰς φ. ἐλθεῖν (cf. Bl., § 47, 2), [[Mrk.4.22|Mrk.4:22]], [[Luk.8.17|Luk.8:17]]; ἐν τῷ φ. (opposite to ἐν τ. κρυπτῷ), [[Rom.2.28|Rom.2:28]]†
_SYN._: see: δῆλος (AS)

G5348.def:
**φθάνω **
[in LXX for נָגַע hi., מְטָא, etc. ;]
1. **to come before another, anticipate **(cl.): with accusative of person(s), [[1Th.4.15|1Th.4:15]]
2. In late writers and M_Gr._ (see Kennedy, _Sources_, 156; Lft., _Notes_, 35), **to come, arrive**: [[Rom.9.31|Rom.9:31]] before εἰς, [[Php.3.16|Php.3:16]] ἄχρι, [[2Co.10.14|2Co.10:14]] ἐπί (cf. Da TH [[Dan.4.21|Dan.4:21]], and see Dalman, _Words_, 107), [[Mat.12.28|Mat.12:28]], [[Luk.11.20|Luk.11:20]], [[1Th.2.16|1Th.2:16]] (cf. προ-φθάνω).†
(AS)

G5342.def:
**φέρω **
[in LXX chiefly for בּוֹא. hi., also for נָשָׂא, etc. ;]
**to bear**;
1. **to bear, carry**: with accusative, [[Luk.23.26; 24.1|Luk.23:26 24:1]], [[Jhn.19.39|Jhn.19:39]], [[Heb.1.3|Heb.1:3]] (see Westc., in l); pass., [[Act.2.2; 27.15, 17|Act.2:2 27:15, 17]] [[Heb.6.1|Heb.6:1]], [[2Pe.1.17-18|2Pe.1:17-18]]; of the mind, [[2Pe.1.21|2Pe.1:21]]
2. **to bear, endure**: with accusative of thing(s), [[Heb.12.20; 13.13|Heb.12:20 13:13]]; with accusative of person(s), [[Rom.9.22|Rom.9:22]]
3. **to bring, bring forward**: with accusative of person(s), [[Act.5.16|Act.5:16]] id. before πρός, [[Mrk.1.32; 2.3; 9.17, 19-20|Mrk.1:32 2:3 9:17, 19-20]]; ἐπί, [[Luk.5.18|Luk.5:18]] with dative, [[Mrk.7.32; 8.22|Mrk.7:32 8:22]]; with accusative of thing(s), [[Mrk.6.27; 11.2; 12.15|Mrk.6:27 11:2 12:15]], [[Luk.15.23|Luk.15:23]], [[Act.4.34, 37; 5.2|Act.4:34, 37 5:2]], [[2Ti.4.13|2Ti.4:13]]; id. before πρός, [[Mrk.11.7|Mrk.11:7]] εἰς, [[Rev.21.24, 26|Rev.21:24, 26]]; ἐπί, [[Mat.14.11|Mat.14:11]], [[Mrk.6.28|Mrk.6:28]]; ἀπό, [[Jhn.21.10|Jhn.21:10]] with dative, [[Mrk.12.15|Mrk.12:15]], [[Jhn.2.8|Jhn.2:8]]; id. before ὧδε, [[Mat.14.18; 17.17|Mat.14:18 17:17]]; before φαγεῖν (sc. τι), [[Jhn.4.33|Jhn.4:33]] τ. δάκτυλον (χεῖρα), [[Jhn.20.27|Jhn.20:27]] pass., ἡ χάρις, [[1Pe.1.13|1Pe.1:13]] διδαχήν, [[2Jn.10|II Jn 10]]; θάνατον (cf. Field, _Notes_, 230), [[Heb.9.16|Heb.9:16]] κρίσιν, [[2Pe.2.11|2Pe.2:11]] κατηγορίαν, [[Jhn.18.29|Jhn.18:29]] αἰτίαν, [[Act.25.18|Act.25:18]] αἰτιώματα, [[Act.25.7|Act.25:7]], Rec.
4. **to bear, produce, bring forth**: καρπόν, [[Mat.7.18|Mat.7:18]], [[Mrk.4.8|Mrk.4:8]], [[Jhn.12.24; 15.2, 4-5; 15.8, 16|Jhn.12:24 15:2, 4-5 15:8, 16]].
5. **to bring, lead**: [[Mrk.15.22|Mrk.15:22]], [[Jhn.21.18|Jhn.21:18]], [[Act.14.13|Act.14:13]]; metaphorically, of a gate (ὁδός, cl.), Seq. εἰς, [[Act.12.10|Act.12:10]]
(cf. ἀνα-, ἀπο-, δια-, εἰσ-, παρ-εισ-, ἐκ-, ἐπι-, κατα-, -παρα-, περι-, προ-, προσ-, συν-, ὑπο-φέρω).†
**SYN**: φορέω, which expresses habitual and continuous bearing as distinct from (φέρω) that which is accidental and temporary (cf. [[Mat.11.8|Mat.11:8]], al., see word φορέω, and see Tr., _Syn._, § lviii)
(AS)

G5326.def:
**φάντασμα**, -τος, τό
(φαντάζω), [in LXX: [[Job.20.8|Job.20:8]] A (חִזָּיוֹן), [[Isa.28.7|Isa.28:7]] A, [[Wis.17.15|Wis.17:15]] * ;]
**= φάσμα, an appearance, apparition **(Æsch., al.): [[Mat.14.26|Mat.14:26]], [[Mrk.6.49|Mrk.6:49]] (see _DCG_, i, 111b).†
(AS)

G5302.def:
**ὑστερέω**, -ῶ
(ὕστερος), [in LXX for חָסֵר, חָדַל etc. ;]
to come late, be behind (opposite to προτερέω, φθάνω; with genitive of thing(s), for; with genitive of person(s), later than).
Metaphorical,
1. of persons,
(a) absol., **to come short, fail**: [[Heb.4.1|Heb.4:1]] before ἀπό, [[Heb.12.15.;|Heb.12:15.]]
(b) with genitive of person(s), **to come short of, be inferior to**: [[2Co.11.5|2Co.11:5]] οὐδέν (in nothing, in no respect), [[2Co.12.11|2Co.12:11]]
(with) with reference to things, to come short (of ), **be in want **(of ): with accusative of thing(s), [[Mat.19.20|Mat.19:20]] ([[Sir.51.24|Sir.51:24]]); with genitive of thing(s), [[Luk.22.35|Luk.22:35]] so mid. (Diod., FlJ), [[Rom.3.23|Rom.3:23]] absol., to be in want, suffer want, [[Luk.15.14|Luk.15:14]], [[1Co.8.8|1Co.8:8]], [[2Co.11.8|2Co.11:8]], [[Heb.11.37|Heb.11:37]] ([[Sir.11.11|Sir.11:11]]); opposite to περισσεύειν, [[Php.4.12|Php.4:12]] before ἐν, [[1Co.1.7|1Co.1:7]]

[[Jos.16.19|Joshua 16:19]], [[Isa.57.15|Isa.57:15]]); of God (in cl., of Zeus; Pind., Æsch., al.), ὕ., [[Luk.1.32, 35; 1.76; 6.35|Luk.1:32, 35 1:76 6:35]] (as frequently in [[Sir.4.10|Sir.4:10]], al.); ὁ ὕ., [[Act.7.48|Act.7:48]] ὁ θεὸς ὁ ὕ., [[Mrk.5.7|Mrk.5:7]], [[Luk.8.28|Luk.8:28]], [[Act.16.17|Act.16:17]], [[Heb.7.1|Heb.7:1]] (cf. [[Gen.14.18|Gen.14:18]]).†

**ὑστέρησις**, -εως, ἡ

**φθείρω **
[in LXX chiefly for שָׁחַת hi., pi., also for חָבַל, etc. ;]

G5354.def:
**φθονέω**, -ῶ
